instruction:
Use the ANSYS Fluent GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: 2D pressure-driven channel laminar flow, validating wall shear stress.

Model parameters:
- Rectangular channel: length 200 mm, height 2 mm
- Fluid: water-liquid
- Mesh: structured quadrilateral mesh, element size 0.5 mm

Boundary conditions:
- Inlet: velocity inlet, mean velocity 0.2 m/s
- Outlet: pressure outlet, gauge pressure 0 Pa
- Top and bottom walls: stationary, no-slip

Analysis type: laminar steady-state

Solver setup:
- Pressure-based, steady, laminar model
- Second-order schemes, SIMPLE algorithm
- Hybrid initialization, 500 iterations

Save requirements:
- Case and Data files: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\poiseuille_shear.cas and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\poiseuille_shear.dat
